title: Pokémon Season 17 XY
description: Join Ash accompanied by his partner Pikachu, as he travels through many regions, meets new friends and faces new challenges on his quest to become a Pokémon Master.

episodes.title: S17-E1Kalos, Where Dreams and Adventures Begin!
S17-E7Giving Chase at the Rhyhorn Race!
S17-E21A PokéVision of Things to Come!
S17-E25A Battle by Any Other Name!
S17-E41Battling Into the Hall of Fame!
S17-E45The Clumsy Crier Quiets the Chaos!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x1
episodes_data.description: Ash and Pikachu have arrived in the Kalos region, and they waste no time building excitement and adventure to a fever pitch!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x2
episodes_data.description: After helping an ailing Pokémon, Ash puts everything he’s got on the line, while an entire city bears witness!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x3
episodes_data.description: Ash is eager to catch some Kalos Pokémon, and he’s definitely not alone!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x4
episodes_data.description: As our heroes continue their Kalos region journey, exciting new Pokémon friendships are the order of the day!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x5
episodes_data.description: Ash charges into his first Kalos region Gym battle against a tough and talented opponent. Is he ready to nab his first Gym badge?

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x6
episodes_data.description: Never one to give up, Ash sets his sights on a rematch with Gym Leader Viola in order to win his first Kalos region Gym badge!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x7
episodes_data.description: There’s an opportunity to be part of an exciting Rhyhorn race, and Ash can’t wait to give it a try!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x8
episodes_data.description: After seeing a superstar Pokémon groomer in their guidebook, our heroes are excited to meet him and his assistant in person!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x9
episodes_data.description: As our heroes arrive back in Lumiose City, Clemont and Bonnie reveal a secret that has everyone else in shock!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x10
episodes_data.description: During a visit with Professor Sycamore while in Lumiose City, our heroes encounter a surprising foe of mega-mega proportions!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x11
episodes_data.description: As our heroes continue their journey to Cyllage City and Ash’s next Gym battle, they must confront a most unsavory character in a most unsavory line of work!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x12
episodes_data.description: As our heroes continue their journey to Cyllage City and Ash’s next Gym battle, they must confront a most unsavory character in a most unsavory line of work!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x13
episodes_data.description: What starts out as a typical battle challenge between two Trainers in the middle of the forest leads to a life-changing experience for one young boy!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x14
episodes_data.description: A powerful rainstorm brings our heroes to a scary mansion seeking shelter, with an unexpected outcome!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x15
episodes_data.description: A misunderstanding while camping out for the night turns out to be the perfect opportunity for some serious Pokémon-and-Trainer bonding!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x16
episodes_data.description: A Pokémon mix-up sends our heroes in a mad dash around town!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x17
episodes_data.description: A ninja and his Frogadier agree to help Froakie work on its speed. But will it be enough to slow down Team Rocket?

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x18
episodes_data.description: Arriving in Camphrier Town, our heroes find themselves in the middle of a dilemma of epic proportions!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x19
episodes_data.description: Team Rocket may still be after Pikachu, but for now, everyone’s got another powerful Pokémon on their minds!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x20
episodes_data.description: A visit to an incredible Kalos region battling institution presents our heroes with lasting memories and a surprising revelation!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x21
episodes_data.description: Ash and friends are exploring the world of Pokévision, and it’s chock-full of epic productions and cinematic surprises!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x22
episodes_data.description: A visit by our heroes to an amazing aquarium turns out to reveal the stuff of legends!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x23
episodes_data.description: Ash, Serena, Clemont, and Bonnie meet up with Alexa again, who is covering the new fossil exhibit at the Ambrette Town Museum, meeting the revived fossil Pokémon Amaura and Aurorus in the museum's cold storage. However, Team Rocket arrives to steal Amaura, leaving Ash and his friends on a rescue mission.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x24
episodes_data.description: Ash and his friends make it to Cyllage City, where Ash plans on challenging the Gym Leader Grant. Having already seen his strategy with Onix at the Battle Chateau, Ash plans on having Froakie face the Rock Pokémon in battle, and later Pikachu against Tyrunt.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x25
episodes_data.description: While on the road, Serena makes some Poké Puffs for Pikachu and Fennekin, but her cooking skills are attacked by Miette, who has the Meringue Pokémon Slurpuff. The two decide to head to the next town and hold a Poké Puffs Contest to see who is the better pastry chef.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x26
episodes_data.description: While brushing out her hair, Bonnie tries a new flower accessory, only to discover that a Flabébé is latching onto it because she has lost her Fairy Flower. The gang tries to help Flabébé get a new Fairy Flower, but it appears the season is over.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x27
episodes_data.description: Upon arriving in the next town, Ash learns that the Kalos Region Champion Diantha will be holding an exhibition match, but he misses out on the sign up deadline. He heads to Professor Sycamore's lab, being tasked to help in his research on Mega Evolution, when he meets Diantha there by chance. She allows him a friendly match, Pikachu against her Gardevoir, and she shows she knows what Mega Evolution is.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x28
episodes_data.description: Ash, Serena, and Bonnie must find out who has been impersonating them in the town they have just arrived in.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x29
episodes_data.description: Ash and friends meet up with Korrina and her Lucario, and soon discover that she is the Shalour City Gym Leader, and she seems to possess a Mega Stone.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x30
episodes_data.description: Ash, Serena, Clemont, and Bonnie help Korrina and her Lucario find the Mega Stone Lucarionite in Geosenge Town's caves, only to come face to face with a Blaziken protecting the caves.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x31
episodes_data.description: Korrina finally finds the Lucarionite, but after using it, she loses control of Mega Lucario, who is much too strong for Pikachu to defeat. Her grandfather Gurkinn must step in and take care of matters, with his own Mega Lucario.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x32
episodes_data.description: Korrina's grandfather Gurkinn tasks her with more training to rein in Mega Lucario, and Ash and company accompany her as they travel to Pomace Mountain only to fall into a trap laid by Team Rocket.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x33
episodes_data.description: The group heads into the mountains around Pomace Mountain and meet with Mabel, a flower arranger who has mastered the art of Mega Evolution herself with her Mawile, prompting Korrina to have a friendly match.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x34
episodes_data.description: Continuing on their journey to Shalour City, Ash and his friends come across the Wrestling Pokémon Hawlucha who is protecting a group of Pokémon in the forest from stronger Pokémon like Machamp, Conkeldurr and a Ursaring.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x35
episodes_data.description: At Kalos Canyon, Ash learns of the Sky Battle trend and tries it out with Fletchling and Hawlucha against Sky Trainer Moria and her Talonflame.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x36
episodes_data.description: While travelling in the Reflection Cave, Ash's reflection takes Pikachu away from him, prompting him to follow into a world within the reflection, leaving Clemont, Serena, and Bonnie to find a way to bring him back. After Ash arrives in the Mirror Dimension, he discovers that his mirror self needs help finding his Pikachu.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x37
episodes_data.description: While practicing for his upcoming Gym battle against Korrina with Hawlucha, Froakie, and Clemont, Ash is kidnapped by the Elder Tree Pokémon Trevenant, leaving Froakie and Hawlucha to trust each other in saving Ash, as Trevenant keeps the others at bay with its power over the forest.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x38
episodes_data.description: Ash, Serena, Clemont, and Bonnie make it to Professor Sycamore's Pokémon Summer Camp, where they meet Shauna, Trevor, and Tierno, who have received Bulbasaur, Charmander, and Squirtle from Professor Sycamore for their first Pokémon, and want to test their skills against Ash and his friends.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x39
episodes_data.description: Serena and Shauna decide to have a little PokéVision contest, but while Serena was looking for locations with her friends, she and Ash become trapped at the bottom of a cliff.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x40
episodes_data.description: The summer campers participate in a Pokémon Orienteering stamp rally where they must use their Pokémon to navigate through a course to get stamps at various stations. However, Bonnie and Pikachu get lost in the foggy woods and come across a mysterious Pokémon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x41
episodes_data.description: After all of the activities at the Pokémon Summer Camp, Ash's team and Tierno's team have the same amount of points. To settle the tie, all six will participate in a tag team match. But first, they have to save Tierno, Shauna, and Trevor's Pokémon from Team Rocket.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x42
episodes_data.description: Before they have their Gym Battle, Ash and Korrina must stop Team Rocket after they have stolen a scroll on Mega Evolution from the Tower of Mastery.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x43
episodes_data.description: Ash challenges Korrina for the Shalour Gym's Rumble Badge, with his Hawlucha, Fletchinder, and Pikachu facing off against her Mienfoo, Machoke, and Mega Lucario.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x44
episodes_data.description: Bonnie and Clemont get into a fight after Bonnie wondered off to look for Chespin and when they encounter two brothers and their Meowstic having a rivalry, it gives Clemont a chance to teach Bonnie a lesson.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x45
episodes_data.description: On their way to Coumarine City, the group goes to a Pokémon Center where Nurse Joy is assisted by a Wigglytuff with bad luck. However, they all soon find themselves having to deal with a Salamence that has gone out of control, and Wigglytuff is the only one who can save Joy.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x46
episodes_data.description: After a Pancham disrupts a Pokémon Showcase and steals Ash's hat and Clemonts's glasses, Serena battles it with her Fennekin in an attempt to capture it and teach it some manners.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x47
episodes_data.description: Clemont returns to his old school where he relives his younger years and reminisces about a Shinx he had befriended, but was forced to leave it behind after his graduation celebration. When he reunites with it, it has evolved into Luxio ever since and Clemont tries to heal the rift that was caused a few years ago.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 17 XY 17x48
episodes_data.description: While walking by herself, Bonnie comes across a group of children who are protecting an injured Lapras from intruders while it rests up before returning to the sea. Bonnie soon joins them in protecting Lapras from Team Rocket.
